panels.title: SocratContainerOOMKilled
panels.description: Condition inputs for SocratContainerOOMKilled. Exact rule expression; gaps mean no matching evaluation or missing telemetry, not proof of health. This rule-scoped panel may show multiple affected series; identify the alert target by its legend labels.

targets.expr:
(
  max by (namespace, pod, container, uid) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{job="kube-state-metrics",reason="OOMKilled"}) == 1
  and on (namespace, pod, container, uid)
  (
    time() - max by (namespace, pod, container, uid) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{job="kube-state-metrics"}) >= 0
    and
    time() - max by (namespace, pod, container, uid) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{job="kube-state-metrics"}) <= 600
  )
)
* on (namespace, pod, uid) group_left (node)
max by (namespace, pod, uid, node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics"})

panels.title: SocratContainerRestartsFrequent
panels.description: Condition inputs for SocratContainerRestartsFrequent. Exact rule expression; gaps mean no matching evaluation or missing telemetry, not proof of health. This rule-scoped panel may show multiple affected series; identify the alert target by its legend labels.

targets.expr:
(
  max by (namespace, pod, container, uid) (
    increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics"}[30m])
    or
    increase(kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics"}[30m])
  ) >= 3
)
* on (namespace, pod, uid) group_left (node)
max by (namespace, pod, uid, node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics"})
